parsed.notes: In the table, the Requirement column comes first and the Actual column second. The leverage ratio is classed as net leverage because the First Amendment (November 5, 2025) lets up to $100 million of unrestricted cash reduce consolidated funded indebtedness. The maximum leverage limit steps up to 4.25 for four consecutive quarters after a designated acquisition. The leverage-based interest margin grids were left out because they only set pricing.
